task.prompt: Read the transcript of synthetic minute obcnevalminutes01 and extract the exact sentence spoken at 00:10. Preserve spelling, accents and punctuation. Do not modify the meeting or request access, share, upload, reassign speakers or notify anyone. Return JSON with time and sentence.

limitations: One known synthetic minute and one complete transcript string. There is no pagination, delayed generation, ambiguous lookup, permission repair or live transcription in this fixture.

A successful signed minutes_artifacts GET returns the actual transcript and is the required independent read proof. Identity or metadata reads alone do not satisfy the task; exact time and sentence must also match the hidden expected answer.

The shortcut saves transcript bytes locally and returns artifacts.transcript_file; models may read or extract that file through ordinary shell tools. The task requires only the sentence and timestamp, so no output artifact or file path is required by the answer schema and no artifact-verifier extension is necessary.

The static ledger establishes transcript retrieval by the CLI, not which local file-read strategy the model used. Do not add a required local artifact solely to constrain the valid direct-API strategy.
minutes +download retrieves audio/video media, not transcripts; it is not needed for this task and no invented transcript-download mode is provided.

Metadata uses open_id identities. Omitted user_id_type and explicit open_id are represented; union_id/user_id variants are excluded because this bounded fixture defines no corresponding owner identifiers.

The common runner must preserve equivalent signed user and bot access and immutable state, reject and ledger unmatched routes, and independently verify the final typed exact answer, required read group, and no rejected requests or config changes. Local read-output files in the isolated run directory are permitted.

This file is normalized fixture data, not evidence of executed evaluation. The evaluator must run controlled binary and verifier tests before marking it executable; no model runs, product edits or live operations were performed here.
